PM-10.detail: Cannot verify / Review: the claim and the model measure different things
PM-10.revision_reason: The plan (page 45) claims approximately 12 months of runway from approximately $7,300, on essential operating costs of approximately $600 per month, stating explicitly that it excludes the owner's wages and assumes no new revenue. The budget's own monthly cost basis is $4,335 (page 5), of which $3,792 is owner's compensation, so the model measures 1.74 months on a basis that includes owner pay. The two figures are not the same measure, and the original Fail compared them as though they were - which is the error PM-10 exists to prevent. The rule reports the model runway on the claim's own basis as missing instead. Revised from the source documents, not from the implementation's output; the plan and budget PDFs were re-verified against the source hashes above on 18 November 2026.
